text:
carl: FYI planning a small blue->green egress stitch tonight 00:30-01:00 UTC. Target steps: 10% every 4m, keepalive probe for 2m after each step. Will pin session-affinity to cookie_v2 during the window. @jin @sara can you ack?
sara: ack. i'll watch EU and US p95s. confirm cookie schema bump is backwards-compatible?
jin: cookie_v2 is backward-compatible for reads; writes will set v2. we'll set `session_affinity: cookie_v2` and a 1h pin. fallback policy: auto-fallback to v2 if p95 > 250ms sustained 2m.
carl: exact rollout plan posted in ops doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/egress-stitch (shortlink). command we'll use to nudge router: `POST /admin/route/shift {"target":"v3","weight":10}`
deploy-bot: deploy-triggered by carl at 2023-11-30T00:32:12Z. starting traffic shift: step 1 -> 10% to v3.
ops-oncall: saw small bump in eu-west p95 to 210ms at 10% but within gut-check. no errors in logs.
deploy-bot: step 2 -> 20% to v3 (2023-11-30T00:36:18Z). keepalive probes running.
pradeep: hold — I'm seeing redis miss rate jump in router-proxy pool, correlate with v3 kv client metrics. increasing error budget observed from 00:35.
sara: +1 hold. p95 eu-west now 320ms at 20% and there's a small tail in 99th. rolling back sounds safer unless pradeep can narrow down quickly.
carl: pausing rollout at 20%. manual pause requested by pradeep.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 20% by operator request (2023-11-30T00:39:02Z).
pradeep: quick check: v3 client uses a new connection pool sizing default that causes transient queueing under burst. i'll push a hotfix to revert pool size in v3; ETA ~15m.
jin: can we route a tiny shadow subset of traffic to v3 backend to validate pool fix before resuming?
sara: perfect — but given p95 breach we should rollback to 100% v2 until fix is live. ops wants a clean baseline while you validate.
carl: decision: rollback to v2. initiate drain and step down weight to 0% over 2 minutes.
deploy-bot: rollback started by carl (2023-11-30T00:42:10Z). decreasing v3 weight -> 10% -> 0% over 2m.
ops-oncall: monitoring: p95 returning to baseline within 1 minute of rollback. alerts quieting.
deploy-bot: rollback complete (2023-11-30T00:44:55Z). traffic 100% v2. release note stub: "egress stitch aborted — v3 connection pool sizing caused p95 regressions in EU. Rollback performed."
carl: noted. pradeep, after hotfix landed can we do a shadow run + 5% probe in low-traffic window before another gradual roll?
pradeep: yes — i'll open a follow-up thread with hotfix CI result. ETA 15m to deploy to staging then shadow.
jin: also adding a safety guard: add `max_p95: 250` check to the router shift job so deploy-bot auto-pauses at threshold.
sara: thanks. i'll update the change window notes and add a line to release notes: "session-affinity pinned during restarts; watch eu-west p95".
carl: great. postmortem action items: (1) revert pool sizing in v3 default or make it opt-in, (2) add max_p95 guard to orchestrator, (3) update runbook. I'll file followups. :thumbsup:
